note: Fixed checks per critical scenario. Texts in `shows` are the oracle's and never change. Controls and fields are named by their role; the evaluating agent writes the journey that reaches each check and names the control or field as it is labelled in the build under test, and the report lists those names for audit.

check_kinds.shows: this text shows on the page (case and spacing ignored)
check_kinds.alert: an error is announced: an element with role alert or aria-live shows text
check_kinds.present: a control or field with this role shows
check_kinds.absent: no control with this role shows
check_kinds.enabled: the control with this role can be used
check_kinds.disabled: the control with this role shows but cannot be used
check_kinds.disabled_or_absent: the control with this role cannot be used or does not show
check_kinds.value: the field with this role holds `equals`

scenario_journey_permission_denied.shows: You do not have permission to create a workspace.
scenario_journey_permission_denied.after: valid profile, then continue with valid workspace fields

scenario_journey_confirm_success.after: valid profile and workspace, confirm on review

scenario_claims_approver_required.shows: Claims over 500 need an approver code.
scenario_claims_approver_required.after: description, amount 620, continue, continue with no approver code

scenario_claims_no_approver_under_limit.shows: Claims up to 500 EUR need no approver.

scenario_claims_submit_success.after: amount 620, approver code MGR-7, continue to review
